Form A (p2) is a printed 20-row boxed grid with NO inked rows; its footer TOTAL cell holds a slashed-zero glyph, and the cover's line-1 THIS cell holds the same slashed-zero glyph. Per the zero-glyph ruling both are 0 (verbatim glyph noted). Rows sum 0.00 = THIS (0), NOT the CUMULATIVE 42,028.39, so the scope of the transcribed rows is PERIOD.

contributions.detail: Report 2 (pp.4-6 + p.10, signed 6/19/2018, period 3/9/2018-6/19/2018). Form A p5 holds 40 inked rows and its TOTAL cell says 'SEE ATTACHED SHEET'; the typed continuation sheet p6 holds 3 more rows and prints 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS: $29,152.93'. The 43 rows sum to exactly 29,152.93, which is the cover's line-1 THIS cell. The CUMULATIVE cell 29,728.39 = 575.46 (a prior-cycle rollover the filer annotated '(rollover from 2016 campaign)') + 29,152.93, so the rows are PERIOD scope.

expenditures.detail: Report 2's Form B is the LAST page of the PDF (p10), out of order behind report 3's pages. Its 34 rows sum to exactly 27236.46 = the sheet's printed TOTAL and the cover line-3 CUMULATIVE cell. The line-3 LAST and THIS cells were both left blank on this cover, so for expenditures this is the first report of the cycle and period == cumulative; recorded as cumulative per the addendum's coincidence rule. Confirmed independently by report 3's cover, whose line-3 LAST cell prints 27236.46.

contributions.detail: Report 3 (pp.7-9, signed 10/30/2018, period 6/29/2018-10/30/2018). 15 inked Form A rows sum to exactly 12,300 = printed TOTAL = cover line-1 THIS. CUMULATIVE is 42028.39, so PERIOD scope.

expenditures.detail: 8 inked Form B rows sum to exactly 5920.21 = printed TOTAL = cover line-3 THIS. CUMULATIVE is 33156.67, so PERIOD scope.

gates.page_subtotal: ALL SIX printed schedule totals gate EXACTLY. p2 zero inked rows = printed TOTAL slashed-zero (0). p3 one row 220,28 = printed TOTAL 220.28. p5 40 rows (28,402.93) + p6 3 rows (750.00) = 29,152.93 = p6's printed 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS: $29,152.93' (p5's own TOTAL cell reads 'SEE ATTACHED SHEET', not a figure). p8 15 rows = 12,300 = printed TOTAL 12,300. p9 8 rows = 5920.21 = printed TOTAL 5920.21. p10 34 rows = 27236.46 = printed TOTAL 27236.46.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py on p5 returned only 17 of the grid's rules (deskew 0.7 deg) and is not usable as the count here; counted INK instead with a per-page dark-pixel projection over the amount column and confirmed each count against the page image: p2 0 inked of ~20 bands; p3 1 of ~40; p5 40 of 40 available bands (the grid is full and the filer spilled onto an attachment sheet); p6 3 of 3 typed rows; p8 15 inked of ~40; p9 8 inked of ~40; p10 34 inked of ~40. Every count is corroborated by its schedule total closing to the cent.
gates.geometry_proof: p5: first-row crop renders '$ 110.00 / No' (Gary Tumer) and last-row (40) crop renders '[ZIP tail] | $ 4202.59 | yes' (Jill Almquist; the address tail visible in the crop is discarded here per the privacy rule); the control one row-pitch past row 40 renders the TOTAL line, i.e. the grid has ended - no row 41 exists. Two additional index checks at rows 19 and 20 rendered '565 Ridgecrest ... 100.00' (VanMeter) and '...eorge, 8477 | 2,000.00' (Wade) as expected, which is what caught and fixed an off-by-one in the first geometry model. p10: first-row crop renders 'hing County Republican Party | Table at Lincoln Day Breakfast | $ 300.00' and row-34 crop renders 'Washington County Rep. Party | Table at Convention | $ 100.00'; control one pitch below renders an EMPTY grid row (printed '$' only). p9: row-1 crop renders 'cebook | Advertising | $ 343.74', row-8 crop renders 'int Place | Stickers | $ 174.78', control below is empty. p3: the single row's crop renders 'LL ALMQUIST | FACEBOOK BOOST REIMB. | $ 220,28'.
gates.balance_chain: Closes exactly on all three covers AND chains across all three reports. R2: 29,728.39 - 27,236.46 = 2,491.93 = printed line-4 CUMULATIVE. R3: 42,028.39 - 33,156.67 = 8,871.72 = printed. R1: 42,028.39 - 33,376.95 = 8,651.44 = printed. CROSS-FILING CHAIN (the swapped-cover test): R2 cumulative contributions 29,728.39 = R3's line-1 LAST cell; R3 cumulative 42,028.39 = R1's line-1 LAST cell; R2 cumulative expenses 27,236.46 = R3's line-3 LAST cell; R3 cumulative expenses 33,156.67 = R1's line-3 LAST cell. All four links close to the cent, which is what proves the out-of-order stapling - in particular that the LAST page of the PDF (p10) is report 2's Form B, not report 3's. Note R2's line-1 LAST cell 575.46 is annotated by the filer '(rollover from 2016 campaign)', i.e. a prior-cycle carry-in, not a prior report in this cycle.

escalation_note: 600 dpi amount-column band re-reads over p5 rows 1-40 (4 crops + 2 tail crops); 600 dpi anchor-grid crops of all three covers (p1, p4, p7); 1200 dpi crop of p10's date column (settles row 4 as 9/18/18, outside the report period); 1200 dpi crops of p3's amount cell and its printed TOTAL (settles decimal comma in the row vs period in the total); 600 dpi index-verification crops on p5 rows 1/2/19/20/39/40, p9 rows 1/8, p10 rows 1/34 plus controls.
notes: BUNDLE OF 3 REPORTS, STAPLED OUT OF CHRONOLOGICAL ORDER AND WITH ONE SCHEDULE DETACHED FROM ITS COVER. Chunk file says n_reports=3 - CONFIRMED, n_reports_in_pdf=3. Page order is: report 1 = the LATEST filing (pp.1-3, signed JAN 3 2019, period 10-31-18..12-31-18); report 2 = pp.4-6 (signed 6/19/2018) whose Form B is the LAST page of the PDF, p10; report 3 = pp.7-9 (signed 10/30/2018). report_no follows the addendum's rule (report 1 = the report whose pages begin the PDF) and the top-level recon is report 1's. The p10-belongs-to-report-2 assignment is not a judgement call: p10's printed TOTAL 27236.46 is report 2's line-3 CUMULATIVE and report 3's line-3 LAST, and p10 carries in-kind rows for Ceri Steele 465.34 and Judy Bozeman 575.00 that appear as report 2 contributions on p5. TWO FORM GENERATIONS ARE NOT IN PLAY: all three reports are Generation 2 (WASHINGTON COUNTY CANDIDATE FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT, Washington County Code 1-7-1), with an In Kind? column on Form A and printed footer TOTALS on both schedules. MIXED HAND: report 1's cover and schedules are handwritten; reports 2 and 3 are typed. Chunk file says candidate 'GILBERT MICHAEL ALMQUIST', office 'Commission Seat A'. The covers read 'GILBERT MICHAEL ALMQUIST' / 'Gilbert M. Almquist' / 'Gilbert Michael Almquist' and the Office line reads 'WASHINGTON COUNTY COMMISSIONER' on reports 1 and 3 and is LEFT BLANK on report 2's cover (p4). NO SEAT LETTER IS PRINTED ANYWHERE IN THE DOCUMENT - 'Seat A' is the index's attribution, not the form's; the 'Representative District' and 'In the ___ School District' lines are blank on all three covers. County office, in scope. The filer contributed to his own campaign (Gilbert Almquist 3600.00 on p5, 4,000.00 on p8) and his spouse Jill Almquist appears both as a 4202.59 in-kind contributor (p5) and as the payee on many in-kind expenditure lines (p10) - reported as printed. Candidate home street address, ZIP and home/business phone are printed in the clear on all three covers and were discarded at read time; donor street addresses and ZIPs likewise.
